exercises.title: Pilates Glute Bridge
exercises.description: Lie on your back with knees bent, squeeze glutes and lift hips upward.
how_to_do: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Engage your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift your hips upward until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower down slowly to the starting position.
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back excessively at the top of the movement.
Pushing through the toes instead of driving down through the heels.
Letting knees cave inward during the lift.
breathing_tips: Exhale as you lift your hips up towards the ceiling.
Inhale slowly as you lower back down to the floor.
Do not hold your breath; holding your breath can cause your body to tense up and make the exercise more difficult.

exercises.title: The Hundred
exercises.description: Classic Pilates core series with coordinated arm pumps and breath.
how_to_do: Lie on your back, curl head and shoulders up, and float legs to tabletop or extended.
Reach arms long by your sides.
Pump the arms up and down while holding the curl.
Complete five short breaths in and five out for ten breath cycles.
common_mistakes: Tucking the chin too hard into the chest.
Letting the low back peel off the mat.
Holding the breath during the pumps.
breathing_tips: Keep the breath audible and rhythmic.

exercises.title: Mermaid Side Stretch
exercises.description: Kneel and reach overhead to open the side body.
how_to_do: Sit in a Z-sit or kneeling mermaid position.
Reach the top arm overhead toward the opposite side.
Keep both sit bones grounded as you lengthen.
Return to center and switch sides as programmed.
common_mistakes: Twisting instead of pure side bend.
breathing_tips: Exhale to deepen the side stretch.

exercises.title: Pilates Squat Pulse
exercises.description: Hold a squat and pulse to keep the thighs working continuously.
how_to_do: Stand with feet hip-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Sit hips back and down while keeping heels grounded.
Pulse an inch up and down at the bottom of the squat.
Stand tall to finish and reset.
breathing_tips: Keep a steady breath through the pulses.

exercises.title: Spine Stretch Forward
exercises.description: Sit tall and fold forward over straight legs to lengthen the back body.
how_to_do: Sit tall with legs extended and feet flexed.
Inhale to lengthen the crown of the head upward.
Exhale and articulate the spine forward over the legs.
Inhale to stack the spine back to tall sitting.
common_mistakes: Collapsing the chest instead of articulating vertebra by vertebra.
Rounding from the lower back only.

exercises.title: Side-Lying Leg Lift
exercises.description: Lie on your side and lift the top leg with control to fire the outer hip.
how_to_do: Lie on your side with legs stacked and hips stacked.
Rest your head on your bottom arm or a small pillow.
Lift the top leg to hip height without rolling backward.
Lower with control and repeat.
common_mistakes: Lifting the leg too high and losing pelvic stability.
Using momentum instead of controlled lifts.
breathing_tips: Exhale as you lift the leg.
Keep ribs soft and breathing quiet.
